report_name: Microsoft Patches Actively Exploited Zero-Day CVE-2026-68820

threat_actors.name: Lazarus Group
threat_actors.description: North Korean state-sponsored threat actor that actively exploited CVE-2026-68820 in their "Operation Dream Job" campaign to deploy the FudModule rootkit and gain SYSTEM-level privileges.
threat_actors.goals: Gain SYSTEM-level privileges on compromised machines and conduct espionage against defense and aerospace sectors.

attack_patterns.name: Exploitation for Privilege Escalation
attack_patterns.description: The Lazarus Group exploited CVE-2026-68820, a use-after-free vulnerability in afd.sys, to escalate privileges to the SYSTEM level on compromised machines.

attack_patterns.name: Disable or Modify Tools
attack_patterns.description: The FudModule rootkit, deployed by the Lazarus Group, is used to disable EDR solutions on compromised systems.

attack_patterns.name: Rootkit
attack_patterns.description: The Lazarus Group deployed the FudModule kernel-mode rootkit to maintain persistence and hide its activities after gaining SYSTEM-level privileges.

malware.name: FudModule
malware.description: A new kernel-mode rootkit deployed by the Lazarus Group after exploiting CVE-2026-68820. It is used to maintain persistence, escalate privileges, and disable EDR solutions.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-68820
vulnerabilities.description: A high-severity use-after-free vulnerability in the Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock (afd.sys) that allows a locally authenticated attacker to escalate privileges to SYSTEM. It was actively exploited as a zero-day by the Lazarus Group.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-62832
vulnerabilities.description: A publicly disclosed privilege escalation flaw in the Windows User Profile Service, noted by Microsoft as "more likely to be exploited."

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-72971
vulnerabilities.description: A low-impact tampering vulnerability in the Windows Container Isolation FS Filter Driver.
affected_products: Windows Container Isolation FS Filter Driver

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-62878
vulnerabilities.description: A potentially wormable stack-based buffer overflow in Windows DNS Server that could lead to remote code execution.

campaigns.name: Operation Dream Job
campaigns.description: A campaign by the Lazarus Group that involved exploiting the CVE-2026-68820 zero-day to deploy the FudModule rootkit.

identities.name: Defense and aerospace sectors
identities.description: Industry sectors targeted by the Lazarus Group in campaigns utilizing vulnerabilities like CVE-2026-68820.

indicators.name: FudModule Rootkit File IOC
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: FudModule Rootkit File Name IOC
id: 1a2b3c4d-5e6f-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5e
status: experimental
description: Detects the presence of the FudModule.sys rootkit file, associated with the Lazarus Group.
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/august-2026-patch-tuesday-microsoft-fixes-421-cves-one-exploited-zero-day/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-12
tags:
  - attack.t1014
level: critical
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\FudModule.sys'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the FudModule.sys rootkit file associated with Lazarus Group's exploitation of CVE-2026-68820.

indicators.name: Suspicious SYSTEM Process Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious SYSTEM Process Creation from User-Level Parent
id: 2b3c4d5e-6f7a-4b8c-9d0e-1f2a3b4c5d6f
status: experimental
description: Hunts for processes created with SYSTEM integrity from parent processes running with a lower integrity level, which can be an indicator of privilege escalation like CVE-2026-68820.
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/august-2026-patch-tuesday-microsoft-fixes-421-cves-one-exploited-zero-day/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-12
tags:
  - attack.t1068
  - attack.privilege_escalation
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    IntegrityLevel: 'System'
  filter_legit_parent:
    ParentIntegrityLevel: 'System'
  condition: selection and not filter_legit_parent
indicators.description: Detects a behavioral pattern indicative of privilege escalation where a new process is created with SYSTEM integrity from a parent process that was not itself running as SYSTEM.
